quote: People can stand what is true,for they are already enduring it.
content: The Huntington's case has been studied and it goes the essay's way. In the first prospective cohort followed after predictive testing became available, both carriers and non-carriers showed better psychological wellbeing at twelve months than those who remained untested, with the untested group showing the highest distress (Wiggins et al. 1992); low uptake reflects the cost of the decision, not evidence that knowing is worse. Golman and colleagues also document the costs of avoidance alongside its rationality. The litany is a therapist's encouragement and it is also, on the one case the annotation chose, empirically correct.
